title: The review's worktree removal (swap/clear) asks first when board edits never reached GitHub
notes: Follow-up to #393 and #400 (ship-decision-7 records the gap). The worktree list's d now asks boardNotOnOrigin through the keeper's remove (removalOf's boardChecked, src/main/actions/worktree/remove.ts, src/main/ship/worktree-keeper.ts), but the review's removal when it swaps or clears a worktree still forces past uncommitted board edits that are not on origin. Example: a card edit made in a worktree while offline is lost when the review swaps it. Do: route that removal through the same kept check, so it keeps the worktree and says which files instead. Test beside the existing ones.

comments.body: Pull request #405 opened: Keep a reviewed worktree whose board edits never reached origin https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/405

Review loop converged, ready to merge. 3 rounds, 10 findings fixed, 0 rejected, nothing open. Commits 31b11c68 e5a28977 c1d7813e bb9f9bcd; CI passed on bb9f9bcd. No conflict with main. Scope matches the card: the swap and clear removals now go through the kept board-on-origin check and name the files. Wording changed from the card's own example: the docs now describe the case as a card file written past the board command or in an older worktree, not an offline edit. A refused review also no longer fetches origin when work changes already block it.
Pull request #405 merged: Keep a reviewed worktree whose board edits never reached origin https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/405
